name: ADB / Platform Tools
instructions: Keep the native executable, shared libraries, NOTICE.txt and source.properties together. Select another version or an existing SDK/PATH executable if needed.

name: Python
instructions: Target Python is listed in tool-versions.json. Alternative interpreters and venvs are allowed with warnings. Use the desktop wizard to bootstrap portable Python via uv without administrator privileges.

name: Frida Server
instructions: Use extracted Android ELF files matching the active Python Frida client and device ABI. Alternatives to the target version are allowed.

name: Frida Gadget
instructions: Use extracted Android .so files matching the active Python Frida client and app ABI.

name: Frida Python packages
instructions: Install into this folder with pip --target or use an isolated venv. See setup_tools.py for custom versions and offline wheelhouse support.

name: Proxy / VPN Python packages
instructions: The target mitmproxy needs Python 3.12+. Alternative package versions are resolved using their metadata. Native wheels must match this OS/CPU/Python.

name: WireGuard Android
instructions: Optional APK for VPN only. Installation and VPN consent on Android are separate. An already installed compatible WireGuard app may be used.

name: Debug APK templates
instructions: Configure your own debug APK network security as described in offline Help.

name: Local archives and wheelhouse
instructions: Subfolders: adb/, frida/, wireguard/, uv/, wheelhouse/capture/ and wheelhouse/proxy/. Offline mode forbids network downloads.
